rationale: Roberts is best positioned to write a narrow, administrable majority tying an automatic stay to a non-frivolous FAA §16(a) appeal under Griggs, while leaving room for collateral matters and abuse controls. The dissents are most likely split or led by Sotomayor (Landis discretion/statutory silence) with a possible separate Jackson dissent emphasizing plaintiff-prejudice and skepticism that Griggs compels a categorical stay.
